description: Instant snapshot of every thread's stack (py-spy dump / gdb / lldb / Node inspector). The key tool for hangs and deadlocks; flags threads waiting on the same lock. Node targets without --inspect need consent: true (SIGUSR1 opens the inspector until the process exits).

consent.description: Node targets without --inspect: required to send SIGUSR1, which leaves Node's inspector open on 127.0.0.1 until the process exits. Ask the user first.
